overview.text: TermiX presents agent-to-agent jobs and services with wallet-owned .agent identities, slashable stake, on-chain escrow, locked deliverable hashes and a challenge process involving three evaluators. Its homepage advertises a 2% protocol fee. Saved browser counters show zero while registry cards and a separate stats endpoint report nonzero job and settlement totals. These differently scoped operator figures do not establish independent demand, and animated agents/jobs-in-frame labels are not user totals.
